subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept this combined persistent-storage migration—including agent schema v12, shared diagnostic-event ordering changes, and the changed memory-event artifact contract—after reviewing real upgrade evidence?
rationale: The PR deliberately alters durable state ownership and a schema version; repository policy reserves that compatibility decision for explicit human acceptance rather than an automated repair or review gate.

options.title: Approve after upgrade proof
options.body: Confirm the storage contract and require a redacted real upgrade/doctor transcript covering the affected journals before merge.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Split the agent-schema or public memory-artifact portions into a separately owned PR if their compatibility contract needs independent review.

recommendation.title: Approve after upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the storage contract and require a redacted real upgrade/doctor transcript covering the affected journals before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related SQLite storage migration makes this the strongest available adjacent routing candidate, though direct ownership of this PR is not proven.
